The main takeaway from our work is that
the evolution of a relatively small brain may have been as important as the evolution of a big brain in determining the evolution of basic cranial base morphology.

the evolution of basiccranial flexion is not a simple consequence of brain expansion per se, but rather a complex consequence of the evolution of the non-cortical components of brain size, as well as of body size.
